description: Implementation of WMLMapPoint class for managing map point data in Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including terrain and unit info with serialization support.

classes.name: WMLMapPoint
classes.description: Represents a map point with terrain and units, supporting serialization and unit management per difficulty level.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Default initializer, calls initWithCode: index: with zero values.

methods.name: initWithCode:index:
methods.description: Initializes map point with specific terrain code and index.

methods.name: initFromCode:
methods.description: Initializes map point from terrain code, determining terrain index.

methods.name: dealloc
methods.description: Releases retained objects during deallocation.

methods.name: encodeWithCoder:
methods.description: Encodes object state for serialization.

methods.name: initWithCoder:
methods.description: Decodes object state from serialized data.

methods.name: terrainID
methods.description: Returns terrain ID.

methods.name: setTerrainID:
methods.description: Sets terrain ID.

methods.name: setCode:
methods.description: Sets terrain code.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns terrain code.

methods.name: setCodeWithString:
methods.description: Sets terrain code from NSString.

methods.name: setUnitID:type:side:forDifficulty:
methods.description: Sets unit ID, type, and side for a specific difficulty.

methods.name: clearUnitForDifficulty:
methods.description: Removes unit info for a specific difficulty.

methods.name: getUnitIDForDifficulty:
methods.description: Retrieves unit ID for a difficulty.

methods.name: getUnitTypeForDifficulty:
methods.description: Retrieves unit type for a difficulty.

methods.name: getUnitSideForDifficulty:
methods.description: Retrieves unit side for a difficulty.

methods.name: updateMapPointUnits:forDifficulty:
methods.description: Updates unit ID based on conversion array for a difficulty.

methods.name: mapPointUnitInfoToString:characterTo:characters:
methods.description: Generates string descriptions of units/characters at map point for all difficulties.

methods.name: mapPointCharacterInfoForDifficulty:toString:characterTo:characters:
methods.description: Appends info about unit/character for a specific difficulty to provided strings.

methods.name: deleteSideWithDict:
methods.description: Deletes or adjusts units associated with a side based on mode and difficulty.
